newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 7.4 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 7.4 pct in 1996.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose a preliminary 7.4 percent in 1996, up from a 3.6 percent rise in the previous year, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
Industrial sales rose 6.7 percent last year, it added.
In December last year, Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose a preliminary 13.9 percent compared with the same month in 1995, and rose 0.1 percent when compared to November 1996.
Industrial sales rose 14.9 percent in December against the same period in 1995, but fell 4.1 percent when compared to the previous month, it added.
